decisions.statement: A transaction of zero is refused.
A transaction this project creates has the tag saying a machine made that transaction.
A row created and then refused its tag is refused loudly.
A transfer is a row out of one category and a row into another category against one account.
A transfer moves a positive amount.
A negative amount is refused rather than reversed.
A transfer from a category to itself is refused.
The balance is updated unless the caller says otherwise.
